caseName: Miller-Wohl Co. v. Commissioner of Labor & Industry of Montana
caseNameFull: Miller-Wohl Co., Inc. v. Commissioner of Labor and Industry of Montana
judges: Appeal, Blackmun, Dismiss, Question, Stevens, Want

opinions.text:
Appeal from Sup. Ct. Mont. Judgment vacated and case remanded for further consideration in light of California Federal Savings & Loan Assn. v. Guerra, ante, p. 272.

Justice Blackmun, Justice Stevens, and Justice Scalia would dismiss the appeal for want of substantial federal question.
